in_sanskrit.name: संतोष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name संतोष (Santosh) is derived from the Sanskrit word संतोषः (Santoshaḥ), which means 'contentment', 'happiness', 'satisfaction', or 'joy'. It is a state of mind where one is free from all desires and attains inner peace.

in_hindi.name: संतोष
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name संतोष (Santosh) in Hindi translates to 'संतुष्ट' (Santuṣṭ), which means 'contented' or 'satisfied'.

in_tamil.name: ஸாந்தோஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name संतोष (Santosh) in Tamil is written as ஸாந்தோஷ (Sāndhōṣ), and its meaning is 'समुத्थிரம்' (Samudhiram), which translates to 'a state of contentment or satisfaction'.

in_telugu.name: సంతోశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name संतोष (Santosh) in Telugu is written as సంతోశ (Santōś), and its meaning is 'సంతోశ్య' (Santōśya), which translates to 'contented' or 'satisfied'.

in_marathi.name: संतोष
in_marathi.long_meaning: संतोष हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name संतोष is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘सन्तोषः’ which means contentment, satisfaction, or being pleased within. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often depicted as संतोषनाथ or the lord of contentment.
